summary: The gallery view maintains a consistent structure and clean composition, with minor contrast adjustments needed on secondary node metadata.

issues.title: Low contrast node path text
issues.description: Footer metadata within the canvas nodes has low contrast against the card background.
issues.evidence: Faint text such as 'src/IMG_4821.cr3' and 'recipe/fjord-dusk' is difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase text opacity or use a darker neutral token for node metadata.
